coordinate_system: Fixed camera. 0 degrees faces the viewer. Increasing yaw turns the character first toward screen left. Compass keys identify sprite directions, not an overhead camera.

directions.visibility: Faces the viewer directly; original front source.
Front and screen-left-facing profile are visible; turn the entire body toward screen left.

directions.target_view: true side profile facing screen left
directions.visibility: The leading face surface points to the left edge; the far side is naturally occluded.

directions.target_view: rear three-quarter facing away toward screen left
directions.visibility: Mostly back surfaces plus the left-pointing profile; front face is normally hidden.
The back faces the viewer. Do not show front eyes, mouth or front-only ornaments.

directions.target_view: rear three-quarter facing away toward screen right
directions.visibility: Mostly back surfaces plus the right-pointing profile; front face is normally hidden.

directions.target_view: true side profile facing screen right
directions.visibility: The leading face surface points to the right edge; the far side is naturally occluded.
Front and screen-right-facing profile are visible; turn the entire body toward screen right.
